phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 74 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 74 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 546 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Short-Stroke Pulse & Operating Impulse

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 8-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the SPAS-12 staged for its 240 RPM (4 rds/sec semi-auto) cadence.

zh.headline: 弗兰奇 SPAS-12 双模式战术霰弹枪：1979 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 意大利弗兰奇 SPAS-12（特种用途自动霰弹枪）通过护木前方的锁钮瞬间切换导气半自动与手动泵动模式：发射全威力鹿弹时可达 4 发/秒，发射低压催泪弹或橡皮弹时则切入手动泵动确保绝不卡弹。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：SPAS-12 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1979 年问世的 弗兰奇 SPAS-12 双模式战术霰弹枪 由意大利路易吉·弗兰奇兵工厂（Luigi Franchi S.p.A.）主导研制，定位为经典的气动半自动/泵动双模式霰弹枪。1979 年问世的 SPAS-12 虽然总产量仅约 37,000 支，却凭借极具工业科幻感的穿孔散热罩与顶折钢托成为二十世纪最具辨识度的经典战斗霰弹枪。
意大利弗兰奇 SPAS-12（特种用途自动霰弹枪）通过护木前方的锁钮瞬间切换导气半自动与手动泵动模式：发射全威力鹿弹时可达 4 发/秒，发射低压催泪弹或橡皮弹时则切入手动泵动确保绝不卡弹。 整件装备总长 1,041 mm（折叠 710 mm）、空重 4.4 kg，成为同期霰弹枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1979 年，意大利路易吉·弗兰奇兵工厂（Luigi Franchi S.p.A.）推出了划时代的弗兰奇 SPAS-12 双模式战术霰弹枪。1979 年问世的 SPAS-12 虽然总产量仅约 37,000 支，却凭借极具工业科幻感的穿孔散热罩与顶折钢托成为二十世纪最具辨识度的经典战斗霰弹枪。 它的核心设计聚焦于独创导气半自动与手动泵动双模式机构，兼顾高速火力与特种低压弹药，奠定了其在霰弹枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 弗兰奇 SPAS-12 双模式战术霰弹枪 的机械灵魂在于其「短行程环形导气半自动 / 手动泵动一键切换 · 顶折钢托」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物精加工而成。标志性穿孔冲压钢散热护罩与顶折金属骨架枪托配前臂单手托钩，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。弗兰奇 SPAS-12 双模式战术霰弹枪 采用短行程环形导气半自动 / 手动泵动一键切换 · 顶折钢托。在每个击发周期中，独立短行程活塞瞬时脉冲撞击枪机框，将热负荷与振源隔离在机匣前方。借助硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了标志性穿孔冲压钢散热护罩与顶折金属骨架枪托配前臂单手托钩。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 12 Gauge (70mm / 2.75") 弹药规格与 546 mm（21.5 in 镀铬滑膛枪管 · 标志性穿孔散热护罩），最高工作膛压约 74 MPa，可赋予弹头 400 m/s 的出膛初速与 3,050 J 动能，有效作用距离达 45 米。
内膛技术特点方面，18.5 mm 内壁镀铬滑膛管，可加装鸭嘴式水平散射喉缩器。同时，弹仓截断按钮允许在管状弹仓满弹状态下快速单发换装独头弹，令其在 240 发/分（半自动 4 发/秒） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 546 毫米身管与 12 Gauge (70mm / 2.75") 口径，弗兰奇 SPAS-12 双模式战术霰弹枪 实现了每秒 400 米的初速与 45 米有效射程。18.5 mm 内壁镀铬滑膛管，可加装鸭嘴式水平散射喉缩器，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 8 发容量的枪管下方管状内置弹仓与 38 mm 膛轴设计，弗兰奇 SPAS-12 双模式战术霰弹枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 22.2 N·s 水平。铝合金机匣内嵌精钢闭锁滑块，可外接 12 号鸭嘴型水平扇面喉缩。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-76）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 8 发容量的枪管下方管状内置弹仓与出色的整体工效，铝合金机匣内嵌精钢闭锁滑块，可外接 12 号鸭嘴型水平扇面喉缩。欢迎在 BAY-76 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 弗兰奇 SPAS-12 双模式战术霰弹枪 的机械魅力。

en.deck: The iconic Italian Franchi SPAS-12 switches instantaneously between short-stroke gas semi-automatic fire for full-power buckshot and manual pump operation for low-pressure baton or tear-gas shells, wrapped in a perforated steel heatshield and top-folding hook stock. acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the SPAS-12
paragraphs: Introduced in 1979 by Luigi Franchi S.p.A. in Italy, the Franchi SPAS-12 Dual-Mode Shotgun emerged as a defining Dual-Mode Semi-Auto / Pump Shotgun. Despite only ~37,000 units produced between 1979 and 2000, the SPAS-12’s perforated heatshield and top-folding stock made it an enduring icon of tactical firearm engineering.

The iconic Italian Franchi SPAS-12 switches instantaneously between short-stroke gas semi-automatic fire for full-power buckshot and manual pump operation for low-pressure baton or tear-gas shells, wrapped in a perforated steel heatshield and top-folding hook stock. Measuring 1,041 mm (710 mm folded) at an unloaded weight of 4.4 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Combat Shotgun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1979, Luigi Franchi S.p.A. of Italy introduced the Franchi SPAS-12 Dual-Mode Shotgun. Despite only ~37,000 units produced between 1979 and 2000, the SPAS-12’s perforated heatshield and top-folding stock made it an enduring icon of tactical firearm engineering. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Selectable gas semi-auto and manual pump modes handle both buckshot and less-lethal loads — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Franchi SPAS-12 Dual-Mode Shotgun sits its Selectable Short-Stroke Annular Gas Semi-Auto & Manual Pump-Action. Throughout every firing cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver, containing 74 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Signature perforated steel heatshield and top-folding stock with forearm support hook, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Franchi SPAS-12 Dual-Mode Shotgun relies on Selectable Short-Stroke Annular Gas Semi-Auto & Manual Pump-Action. During each cycle, independent short-stroke piston delivers a clean impulse while isolating heat forward of the receiver. Machined from hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Signature perforated steel heatshield and top-folding stock with forearm support hook.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 12 Gauge (70mm / 2.75") with 546 mm (21.5 in Chrome-Lined Smoothbore · Perforated Heatshield), the Franchi SPAS-12 Dual-Mode Shotgun develops 400 m/s muzzle velocity and 3,050 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 45 meters.

Internally, 18.5 mm chrome-lined smoothbore accepting specialized horizontal diverter chokes. Combined with its 240 RPM (4 rds/sec semi-auto) tempo, Magazine cutoff button enables rapid single-shell chambering of slugs, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 12 Gauge (70mm / 2.75") through its 546 millimeter bore, the Franchi SPAS-12 Dual-Mode Shotgun achieves 400 meters per second and 45 meters of effective reach. 18.5 mm chrome-lined smoothbore accepting specialized horizontal diverter chokes.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 8-round under-barrel tubular magazine with a 38 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 22.2 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Alloy receiver with steel locking block accepts duckbill horizontal dispersion chokes.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-76), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.

Explore BAY-76 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the Franchi SPAS-12 Dual-Mode Shotgun.
